scripts.docker:up: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis minio latex_engine
scripts.regression: npm run pipeline:guard --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm run wait:db && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=backend
